lean.statement:
{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let Λ := J.map (fun p : E × E => (p.2,(2 : ℝ) • p.1-p.2))
    IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
    ∃ S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted
        (fun x => -V ((1/2 : ℝ) • (y+x)) - ‖y-x‖^2/(8*η))) ∧
      Λ.IsCondKernel S ∧ Λ.fst = ν ∧ Λ.snd = ν ∧
      ∃ T : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
        IsSelfAdjoint T ∧
        (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖T u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ ∧
          (T u : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[ν] (fun y => ∫ x, u x ∂S y) ∧
          (∫ y, T u y ∂ν) = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
        ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T).IsPositive ∧
        ∃ Γ : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
          Γ.IsPositive ∧ Γ*Γ = ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) ∧
          (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, ‖Γ u‖^2 = ‖u‖^2-‖T u‖^2) ∧
            ∀ Γ' : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
              Γ'.IsPositive →
              Γ'*Γ' = ((1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T) → Γ'=Γ
approved_definition_context: The base is a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including zero dimension. ContDiff order2 means C2; both displayed global Hessian inequalities and positive capped step are literal assumptions.

Measure.tilted denotes normalized exponential tilting. The displayed joint law is the independent-product Gaussian pushforward; second marginal, reflected pushforward, normalized Markov kernel/disintegration/stationary marginals are as displayed. They are produced conclusions.

Lp exponent2 denotes complete real AE square-integrable classes on the actual marginal, not a finite-dimensional space. The density equality holds at every state; conditional integral action is per observable almost everywhere.

Bounded real operator multiplication is composition. Positivity includes symmetry and nonnegative quadratic form. The scalar operator, positive defect and positive root with full energy are produced. Every bounded positive alternative on the SAME marginal with SAME square equals this root; no energy identity is assumed of an alternative. The alternative quantifier is outside the earlier every-observable energy conjunction.
